experience.title: Product Manager - Nutrilinq
bullets: Identified a nutritional support gap in the GLP-1 consumer market through market and literature review of a ~$2.5B category and pitched and developed a supplement concept, collaborating with physicians to finalize product formulation.

Designed and executed go-to-market and commercialization activities by evaluating retail channels, onboarding 45 partners, developing the product website, and supporting sales and promotional efforts to drive distribution.

experience.title: Product Manager Intern
bullets: Coordinated development of a college-guidance application by managing a cross-functional team of 11 interns and volunteers working on financial data research, AI-assisted content generation, and UX/UI design.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant - Global Development and Applied Economics
bullets: Appointed based on maintaining consistently high GPA, demonstrating academic excellence, and grasp over subject matter exemplified by assignments, class discussions, and relevant work experience.
Graded assignments and in class responses for 25 students each semester; coached students to clarify misconceptions and assisted with timely submission of assignments.

experience.title: Founding Director of Programs
experience.org: Connecting Youth To Leaders of Today - Podcast Series
bullets: Cold-invited and interviewed 40+ high-profile policymakers and leaders for Pakistani Student Association Coalition's Webinar series, designing the questions for each conversation to draw substantive, non-obvious insight out of guests practiced at staying on message, with a live student audience.
The series is archived on YouTube to aid research, achieving an average of 3,835 views and ~12.5% monthly subscriber growth.

experience.title: Media and Public Outreach Intern
experience.org: Valley Water - US Government Department for Water (Bay Area)
bullets: Built the department's outreach strategy and wrote the blog and social content that carried it, growing social reach by 101,500 views and blog readership by 1,616 views.

Analyzed and recommended improvements for the Flood Awareness Campaign based on previous year's data impacting 150,000 individuals. Using GIS, identified high-risk communities and strategized effective outreach, evacuation, and rehabilitation plans.

Reviewed outreach and distribution data and identified reliance on English-only flood safety pamphlets. Analyzed neighborhood-level demographic and language data to recommend multilingual materials, specifying which languages to deploy, target neighborhoods, and appropriate distribution points.

experience.title: Fellow, Outstanding Contribution Award
bullets: Analyzed public health and community-level data to identify gaps in First Aid Awareness Programs within underprivileged communities, leading to the design of an Urdu-language intervention to improve accessibility.
Collaborated with 4 doctors to develop a standardized First Aid syllabus in Urdu covering all age groups and core emergency scenarios.
Organized and delivered 5 First Aid awareness sessions, educating 67 students across targeted communities.

experience.title: Outreach Intern
bullets: Managed Middle East, North African regions and later Pakistan, leading presentations in 16 countries to increase Minerva's awareness. Resulted in an average increase of 12,500 applications per year.
Enhanced ties with prestigious educational institutions and USEFP bodies, leading to a 22% growth in Minerva's reach within Pakistan and a 0.6% increase in acceptance rates from the region.

Reviewed data and identified Karachi as an underrepresented city. Implemented targeted strategies, identifying top-performing schools and presenting Minerva to stakeholders resulting in a 400% increase in applications.

experience.title: Environmental Business Consultant
bullets: Analyzed the B-Corp certification framework and evaluation criteria by reviewing questionnaire requirements and scoring methodology in collaboration with a 3-member team to identify priority operational and governance gaps.

Audited business practices against B-Corp standards and developed targeted operational and process recommendations that supported a ~60% increase in the company's B-Corp score and progression toward certification.

experience.title: Research Intern & Project Manager
bullets: Conducted mixed-methods research on homelessness in San Francisco by combining online sources and field observations to review existing policies and service models, identifying gaps in information synthesis and accessibility.

Managed a research team of 4 contributors by setting milestones, coordinating tasks, and monitoring progress against timelines to deliver a consolidated pitch deck with evidence-based recommendations for policy discussion.
